How it works

Booking takes three steps

No account needed. Everything happens on WhatsApp.

Choose your style

Questions

Before you book

How do I book an appointment?

Fill in the booking form on this page. It opens WhatsApp with your details ready to send. The salon replies to confirm.

How much will my hairstyle cost?

The price depends on the style, hair length and materials. Send us a photo of the look you want and we will confirm the cost.

Can I bring a photo of the style I want?

Yes. Send the photo on WhatsApp after you submit your request, or show it when you arrive.

Where is the salon?

We are at Kodie Mowire, adjacent Family Care Hospital. Use the map link in the contact section for directions.
